author: Ryan George Extra Plus!
description:
Get exclusive videos & early access on my Patreon: http://patreon.com/RyanGeorge

Vertical micro-dramas are short low-budget movies shot vertically, cut into 2-minute cliffhanger episodes, and apparently getting more daily screen time than Netflix, Prime Video, and Disney+ combined. I had to understand what was going on, so I sat through all 70 episodes of Resisting Mr. Lloyd: An Age Gap Romance, a story about a construction worker, a billionaire CEO, a senile grandmother who threatens to jump off buildings, and approximately 47 Shein product placements. I now understand everything about the micro-drama industry and I am never doing this again unless this video does well.
